decisions.decision: Move the board's pure rules into apps/copilot-canvas/spec-rules.mjs and bundle it into the plugin with esbuild
decisions.why: A hooks module imports only files inside its plugin and has no Node APIs; one module keeps the board, the viewer and the mod on the same rules
decisions.rejected: Reimplementing the rules in the mod, which would drift

decisions.decision: Do every file read in register.js through $.fs and pass text to the shared rules
decisions.why: Static analysis rejects passing $ into imported helpers

decisions.decision: Refresh the followed spec after each tool call and on a 3 second timer; rescan all folders only at start, on /spec, and after a turn
decisions.why: Capture writes arrive through the agent's tool calls; a full rescan of hundreds of folders every few seconds is waste
decisions.rejected: A timer alone (visible lag) or a watcher (no API)

decisions.decision: Fall back to a text reply when $.session.surfaces() has neither terminal nor desktop
decisions.why: surfaces() is empty under claude -p and the VS Code panel draws no mod UI
decisions.rejected: Always returning text, which duplicates the pane in the terminal

decisions.decision: Keep the hand-picked spec in $.store under follow:<project root>
decisions.why: Survives reloads and restarts without sessions in other projects overwriting it
decisions.rejected: A module variable, lost on every reload

decisions.decision: Generate tests/fixtures/demo-specs.js from specs/_0N_demo-* in the build
decisions.why: Plugin tests cannot import node:fs, so they need the fixtures as a module; the staleness check keeps it real

decisions.decision: The band counts tasks in place of naming the tasks step as done
decisions.why: Reproduces the issue's example 'Plan done · Tasks 7/12 · Implement running'

decisions.decision: The pane opens by itself at session start where something draws
decisions.why: Claude Code places an unasked pane only in a terminal 144+ columns wide, which is the beside-the-transcript case; narrower terminals wait for /spec
decisions.rejected: Opening only on /spec, which hides the pane until asked

decisions.decision: Bare /spec opens the pane on a Specs tab of buttons instead of printing a list where something draws
decisions.why: Picking from the list is one press; the text list stays for surfaces that draw nothing
decisions.rejected: Printing the list in the transcript everywhere

decisions.decision: A refresh whose target moved while it read is dropped, keyed on the target id rather than a generation counter
decisions.why: A generation counter let a timer tick overrule /spec's own refresh, so /spec could answer with the previous spec

decisions.decision: The demo fixtures bundle from the git index
decisions.why: Clicking through the viewer mutates the working copies, which would rewrite the tracked fixture bundle

plan.summary: Plan: a self-contained plugin under apps/claude-mod that reads with $.fs and derives everything through a bundle of the board's pure rules
plan.key_finding: Plugin tests and hooks modules can import only relative files and claude-code, so sharing code means a generated bundle and generated fixtures

tasks.summary: 21 tasks in 8 phases: setup, foundational rules split and build, four story phases on register.js, docs, polish

implement.summary: Claude Code mod at apps/claude-mod: run band, spec pane, /spec with text fallback, built on the board's shared rules bundled from spec-rules.mjs

approach: Split the Copilot board's reader into pure rules (spec-rules.mjs) and IO, and bundle the rules into a self-contained plugin at apps/claude-mod. The plugin's hooks module reads spec folders through $.fs, derives rows, band line and pane model from the shared rules, refreshes after tool calls and on a timer, and answers /spec with a pane or a text reply.

concerns.note: simplified: list rows read a spec's spec.md only when the record lacks specName, and tasks.md only without a record, to keep the scan of hundreds of folders cheap; the followed spec reads both. If list rows ever need task counts, read tasks.md for every row.
claude plugin test needs the Claude Code binary, so CI runs the canvas suites and the bundle staleness check but not the plugin tests; npm run test:mod runs them locally.
Code review ran inside a subagent run of auto, so the nested /code-review + /codex:review dispatch may degrade to /code-review alone.

Doctor: tasks recorded 1 internal boundary where siblings recorded 4, and 1 capture call exited without an outcome (likely a call the subagent's worktree guard refused mid-run). Both self-inflicted by this run; history is append-only, so left as is.

Review gap (round 2, codex): two scanAll calls running at once can finish out of order and leave the older row list; scans only start on /spec, after a main turn and when the Specs tab opens, so it is rare, and the next scan corrects it.

Review gap (round 1, code-review): a spec with no run record sorts by its newest file time, and $.fs.list reports 0 for subfolders where the board stats them, so such specs can sort slightly differently from the Copilot board.

Claude Code's remote rollout switch for installed mods flipped off once mid-run ('the rollout switch was saved off by an earlier session'); one claude -p run refreshed it and the mod loaded again. Users can hit the same message.
